blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday denied Vice President Sara Duterte’s claim that the administration was behind allegations against her. Palace press officer Claire Castro said the vice president should instead answer the accusations and present evidence in her defense. Castro noted that Duterte appeared to be blaming President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. because she could no longer find a defense against the allegations confronting her. “Siguro ’yan talaga ang mangyayari pagka wala ka nang mahanap na pangdepensa, magtuturo ka na lang ng iba,” Castro told reporters in Pasay City.
